The '''C2-R4 Multipurpose Unit''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] series created and manufactured by a colony of [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]]. Despite the Squib's enthusiasm to release their creation onto the market, the C2-R4 was a disaster since they had no defined function or role, and were essentially a collection of household appliances attached to an [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] body shell.

==Description==
The main body of the C2-R4 was a scavenged [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] shell mounted on two [[Tank/Legends|tank]]-style treads. Welded onto the unit was a collection of household appliances linked together by [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] and electrical leads. The [[Knowledge matrix|programming matrices]] were whatever the Squibs could get their hands on, leading to mixture of functions and ability. C2-R4 units were capable of catalytic fuel conversion, enzymatic breakdown, chemical diagnostic programming , and bacterial composting. However, they were also capable of preparing [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] by reprocessing trash along with their attached [[blender]], [[toaster oven]], and [[bang-corn air popper]].<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
The C2-R4 Multipurpose Unit was the brainchild of a colony of [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] who collected [[Realspace/Legends|space]] debris for the [[Squib Merchandising Consortium]]. They came to the conclusion that the material they have been scavenging could be repurposed and built into fully functional droids. With usual Squib enthusiasm, they went to work building the droids without defining their specific function. They were excited to be able to haggle about the price of the units with potential customers and ended up building droids that had a host of devices and technology bolted on to.<ref name="EGTD" />

With no clear design philosophy, the C2-R4 series was a colossal flop. Even [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] did not want a droid capable of creating meals from garbage. While a disappointment to their Squib creators, they still enjoyed the propose of haggling with their bill collectors and the remainder houses. One unit, [[C2-R4]], ended up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and came into the possession of [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. C2-R4 was pressed into service as a distillery, using his combination of equipment to allow Wuher to make a [[Cocktail/Legends|cocktail]] using [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo's]] corpse.<ref name="EGTD" />
